deferred_invariant.ordinary_clean: pending=false: own value and aggregate are both current; left/right child summaries each include their own actions.
deferred_invariant.pending: pending=true: forward/backward already include action, own value excludes action, both child subtrees exclude this parent action.
deferred_invariant.act: Map forward/backward immediately, compose pending action in existing f-after-g order, leave own value untouched. No new allocation or state.
deferred_invariant.push: Before existing two-child propagation, materialize own value with mapping(action,value) once; then propagate and clear pending exactly as before. Reversal phase unchanged.
deferred_invariant.pull: All structural callers push node first, so own value is current before rebuilding; O(N) Cartesian constructor uses new clean nodes. Root commutative reverse/rotate skip-pull and unchanged-length aggregate-onlyapply compatible because they push partial nodes first.
deferred_invariant.public: get/set/erase_value/erase/insert/bound/flatten/ID-position/boundarysearch all push before touching own value. all_prod/full query use already-current aggregate. Copy/move preserve pending state and stale own value consistently. Recycle/clear own and destroy same storage; no ownership or container changes.
deferred_invariant.counts: A pending generation maps the own value at most once on push; several act compositions before push avoid redundant own-value mappings. No extra aggregate mapping in deferred-only.
deferred_invariant.exceptions: Existing copy/move/allocator regression suites pass. Parent proposes restricting new path to trivially copyable large S/F; this additionally preserves nontrivial-value materialization/destruction timing. No new general guarantee for user callbacks throwing is asserted.
